Regin Rose is a casting director and actor of Indian origin. He holds a Master's degree in Performing Arts specializing in Drama and Dramatics/Theatre Arts from Pondicherry University and a B.Sc. in Mathematics from Scott Christian College, Nagercoil. With a strong background in theatre and a passion for teaching, Regin Rose has made a significant impact on the Indian theatre community. He is the founder and director at Medai - The Group Theatre. He also works as an Acting Trainer at Koothu-P-Pattarai and MINDSCREEN FILM INSTITUTE for the past nine years.
He is dedicated to nurturing talent and helping aspiring actors achieve their dreams. In Jan 2019, he founded the Chennai Theatre Academy, providing top-notch training and education to aspiring actors and theatre enthusiasts. He has acted in Gargo (2022), in a single episode of The Family Man (2021), and Ammani (2016) and has worked as the casting director for Vaaitha (2022).
